methods.name: Few-shot sentence generation with GPT-3
methods.description: Samples 5 random sentences from a minority group set, concatenates them with preceding hyphens and trailing newlines, appends a hyphen to prompt generation, and terminates generation upon encountering a newline character.

methods.name: human validation
methods.description: select 156 MTurk workers with prior experience annotating toxic language for data annotation

methods.name: optional survey
methods.description: survey at the end of the annotation task to collect worker demographics
